title.en: Why does a circle’s projection match a spring?

title.en: From circles to waveforms

backgroundNote.zh: 本实验有阻尼与持续驱动；下面的自由振子方程只用于回看符号。暂态是初始状态带来的额外运动，在本页正阻尼模型中会衰减。稳态是随后保留的持续周期运动，不是静止；黏性阻尼通过反向于速度的力耗能。响应图中的 φ 是位移相对驱动力的相位差。
backgroundNote.en: This lab has damping and sustained driving; the free-spring equation below is background for its symbols. A transient is extra motion associated with the initial state; it decays in this positive-damping model. Steady state is the sustained periodic motion left afterward, not rest. Viscous damping removes energy through a force opposing velocity. Here φ is displacement’s phase difference relative to the driving force.

title.zh: 为什么会共振？
title.en: Why does resonance happen?

title.zh: 从测量到控制
title.en: From measurements to control

reason.zh: 一维功沿路径积 F dx，单位 N·m=J；a、b 可选时间端点，但积分变量 x 是位移，不是时间。弹簧往返时各段可做正功或负功。
reason.en: One-dimensional work integrates F dx along the path, in N·m=J. Time bounds a,b choose endpoint positions, but the integration variable x is displacement, not time. Spring work can be positive or negative along different legs.

label.zh: 把净功联系到动能变化
label.en: connects net work with kinetic change

reason.zh: 本例重力与支持力都不做功，弹簧力做功即物块净功。换系统或添加阻尼/驱动后，不能把单个力的功直接等同净功，也不能照搬本例机械能守恒。
reason.en: Here weight and support do zero work, so spring work is the block’s net work. In another system or with damping/driving, one force’s work is not generally net work, and this mechanical-energy conservation statement does not transfer automatically.

reason.zh: 本振子往返一周回到同一位置，正负速度贡献抵消，位移为零；路程为4A。交换积分限使有向积分变号，按时间先后的路程仍非负。
reason.en: One oscillator cycle returns to the same position: opposite velocity contributions cancel, giving zero displacement but distance4A. Reversing limits changes an oriented integral’s sign; chronological path length remains nonnegative.

reason.zh: 本振子的可微位置 x(t) 给出 v=dx/dt、a=dv/dt；有方向的速度可以为负，速率是 |v|。微分描述运动，不是产生运动的物理原因。
reason.en: For this oscillator, v=dx/dt and a=dv/dt. Signed velocity can be negative; speed is |v|. Differentiation describes motion rather than causing it.

reason.zh: 本水平无摩擦弹簧模型中，竖直重力与支持力抵消，水平合外力为 −kx=ma。不能把单个弹簧力在其他系统中也当作净力。
reason.en: In this horizontal frictionless spring model, weight and support cancel vertically; horizontal net force is −kx=ma. A single spring force is not generally the net force in other systems.

reason.zh: 电压与电流的乘积是流入电感的功率，积分得到磁场储能变化。
reason.en: Voltage times current is power entering the inductor; integration gives the magnetic-energy change.

reason.zh: 电容吸收或释放的功率等于其电压与电流的乘积。
reason.en: Power absorbed or released by a capacitor equals its voltage times current.

reason.zh: 电感记住电流，电容记住电压；两者在电路中交换储能，但元件定律不同。
reason.en: Inductors retain current and capacitors retain voltage. Both exchange stored energy, under different component laws.

reason.zh: 开关断开后，电感通过续流二极管继续向输出送电。
reason.en: When the switch opens, the inductor continues delivering current through the freewheel diode.

reason.zh: 关断时电感电流下降，电感右端电势升高，电源与电感共同供能。
reason.en: During OFF, current falls and the right inductor terminal rises; source and inductor deliver energy together.

reason.zh: 电感电流与负载电流的差流入或流出输出电容。
reason.en: The difference between inductor and load current charges or discharges the output capacitor.

reason.zh: 开关闭合时二极管截止，负载由输出电容供电。
reason.en: During ON the diode blocks, and the output capacitor supplies the load.

reason.zh: 开关闭合连接输入；开关断开时续流二极管提供回路。
reason.en: The closed switch connects the input; the freewheel diode provides the OFF loop.

reason.zh: 开关闭合给电感储能，断开时电流经二极管流向输出。
reason.en: ON stores energy in the inductor; OFF routes current through the diode to the output.

reason.zh: 在连续导通理想稳态，伏秒平衡给出 ⟨Vout⟩ = D Vin。
reason.en: Ideal steady-state CCM volt-second balance gives ⟨Vout⟩ = D Vin.

reason.zh: 在恒定直流输入、理想 CCM 的小纹波周期稳态近似下，平均电压 ⟨Vout⟩ ≈ Vin/(1−D)，0<D<1。
reason.en: With constant DC input, ideal CCM and the small-ripple periodic steady-state approximation, ⟨Vout⟩ ≈ Vin/(1−D), with0<D<1.

reason.zh: 实际稳压器可测量输出并调节占空比；本课只解释此接口，不模拟控制器。
reason.en: A real regulator can measure output and adjust duty; this lesson explains the connection without simulating a controller.

reason.zh: 圆上点的纵、横坐标定义正弦、余弦；匀速转动使这些坐标成为时间函数。
reason.en: Vertical and horizontal coordinates define sine and cosine; uniform rotation makes them functions of time.

reason.zh: 单位圆上的点可以写成 cos θ + i sin θ，角度变化对应平面旋转。
reason.en: A point on the unit circle is cos θ + i sin θ; changing its angle rotates it in the plane.

reason.zh: 无阻尼、无外力的理想弹簧振子满足 x″ + (k/m)x = 0，其解为正弦和余弦的组合。
reason.en: An undamped, unforced ideal spring obeys x″ + (k/m)x = 0, whose solutions combine sine and cosine.

reason.zh: 傅里叶分析以不同频率的正弦、余弦或复指数为分量；每个分量有自己的幅度和相位。
reason.en: Fourier analysis uses sine, cosine or complex-exponential components at different frequencies, with their own amplitudes and phases.

reason.zh: 欧拉公式把正弦和余弦写成复指数的组合，复数傅里叶变换由此统一表示正、负频率分量。
reason.en: Euler’s formula expresses sine and cosine as combinations of complex exponentials, allowing the complex Fourier transform to represent positive and negative frequencies together.

reason.zh: 傅里叶级数通过叠加谐波近似周期波形；有限项近似在跳变附近可能出现吉布斯现象。
reason.en: A Fourier series combines harmonics to approximate a periodic waveform; finite sums may show Gibbs overshoot near jumps.

reason.zh: 变换结果包含各频率分量的信息；查看幅度与相位，才能保留一般信号的完整表示。
reason.en: The transform records frequency components; both amplitude and phase are needed for a complete representation of a general signal.

reason.zh: 当相应变换存在时，时域卷积对应频域乘法。本课用有限序列比较直接卷积与频域计算的结果。
reason.en: When the transforms exist, time-domain convolution corresponds to frequency-domain multiplication. This lesson compares direct convolution with frequency-domain computation on finite sequences.

reason.zh: 均匀采样使频谱按采样率周期重复；重复的谱相互重叠时产生混叠。
reason.en: Uniform sampling repeats the spectrum at multiples of the sampling rate; overlap between copies produces aliasing.

label.zh: 受周期驱动时可能共振

reason.zh: 给振子施加周期外力，其稳态响应随驱动频率变化；阻尼决定峰值的强弱与位置。
reason.en: A periodic force produces a frequency-dependent steady-state response; damping affects the peak strength and location.

reason.zh: 在线性系统的频率响应幅度图上，共振表现为某段频率附近的峰；并非所有系统都有明显峰值。
reason.en: In a linear system’s frequency-response magnitude, resonance appears as a peak; not every system has a pronounced one.

label.en: is characterized by its impulse response

reason.zh: 对初始静止的 LTI 系统，把输入分解为加权、平移的单位脉冲，就能由 h 重建输出。
reason.en: For an initially resting LTI system, decompose the input into weighted shifted impulses and reconstruct the output from h.

label.en: convolves with input to produce output

reason.zh: 输出是各个平移冲激响应的加权和，这正是离散卷积 y[n] = Σ x[k]h[n−k]。
reason.en: The output sums weighted shifted impulse responses: precisely the discrete convolution y[n] = Σ x[k]h[n−k].

label.zh: 傅里叶变换给出频率响应

reason.zh: 当冲激响应的傅里叶变换存在时，H 是 h 的频域表示；稳定 LTI 系统满足常用的绝对可积或可和条件。
reason.en: When its Fourier transform exists, h becomes the frequency response H. Stable LTI systems satisfy the usual absolute-integrability or summability condition.

reason.zh: 线性保证输入的加权组合产生相同权重的输出组合；时不变是另一项独立条件。
reason.en: Linearity preserves weighted combinations of input-output pairs; time invariance is a separate condition.

label.zh: 在收敛条件下限制到虚轴
label.en: restricts to the imaginary axis when convergent

reason.zh: 当拉普拉斯变换的收敛域包含虚轴时，在 s = iω 处取值可得到傅里叶变换。
reason.en: If the Laplace region of convergence contains the imaginary axis, evaluating at s = iω gives the Fourier transform.

reason.zh: 对本课中的有理变换，极点的实部关联增长或衰减，虚部关联振荡；还要结合因果性和收敛域判断稳定性。
reason.en: For the rational transforms in this lesson, pole real parts describe growth or decay and imaginary parts describe oscillation; stability also depends on causality and convergence.

reason.zh: 当冲激响应的拉普拉斯收敛域包含虚轴时，H(iω) 给出频率响应。极点靠近虚轴可能形成尖峰，零点也会影响结果。
reason.en: When the Laplace region of convergence of the impulse response contains the imaginary axis, H(iω) gives frequency response. Nearby poles may produce sharp peaks; zeros also matter.

reason.zh: 在矩阵变换下寻找只被缩放的非零向量，就得到 Av = λv 的特征向量问题。
reason.en: Finding nonzero vectors that are only scaled by a matrix leads to the eigenvector equation Av = λv.

reason.zh: 对协方差矩阵，特征向量给出互相正交的主方向，特征值给出沿这些方向的方差。
reason.en: For a covariance matrix, an orthonormal eigenbasis gives principal directions, and eigenvalues give variances along them.

label.en: provides a model for evidence updates

reason.zh: 先验和似然都来自概率模型；贝叶斯公式将它们结合成给定观测后的条件概率。
reason.en: The prior and likelihood come from a probability model; Bayes’ rule combines them into a probability conditional on observations.

label.zh: 在线性高斯条件下形成状态更新
label.en: gives state updates under linear Gaussian assumptions

reason.zh: 在线性动态与观测模型、适当高斯先验和独立高斯噪声条件下，卡尔曼更新可用均值与协方差表示贝叶斯更新。
reason.en: With linear dynamics and measurements, an appropriate Gaussian prior and independent Gaussian noises, Kalman updates express Bayesian updating using means and covariances.

reason.zh: 预测不确定性与测量噪声共同决定增益；模型给出的不确定性必须与真实估计误差区分。
reason.en: Predicted uncertainty and measurement noise jointly determine the gain; model uncertainty must be distinguished from actual estimation error.

label.zh: 提供用于控制的状态估计

reason.zh: 无法直接观测的状态可先估计，再交给控制器；估计质量和模型误差会影响控制效果。
reason.en: Estimate states that cannot be measured directly, then pass them to a controller; estimation quality and model mismatch affect control.

label.en: sets the standard error of a mean

reason.zh: 独立同分布样本方差为 σ² 时，n 个样本的均值方差为 σ²/n；正态近似还需要适用的极限定理条件。
reason.en: For iid samples of variance σ², the mean of n samples has variance σ²/n; a normal approximation additionally needs appropriate limit-theorem conditions.

reason.zh: 按指定概率模型采样，用样本平均估计期望；积分也可改写成相应的期望。
reason.en: Sample from a specified probability model and average to estimate an expectation; integrals can also be written as expectations.

reason.zh: 独立同分布且方差有限时，样本平均的标准误差按 1/√n 缩小；这是误差尺度，不是每次运行的保证。
reason.en: For iid samples with finite variance, the sample mean’s standard error scales as 1/√n; this is an error scale, not a guarantee for each run.

label.zh: 描述独立变量相加的分布

reason.zh: 独立随机变量之和的分布由卷积给出；反复相加后的正态近似需满足中心极限定理的条件。
reason.en: Convolution gives the distribution of a sum of independent random variables; a normal approximation after repeated sums requires central-limit conditions.
